name: Todoist
tagline: Keep your to-do list: add tasks, plan the day and see what is due.
summary: Read and manage the user's Todoist: tasks, projects, labels and reminders. Tasks are completed, rescheduled or deleted only when the user asked for it or approves.
can: Read your tasks, projects and labels, and what is due when
Add tasks, with due dates, priorities and reminders
Complete, reschedule or delete a task, only after you approve it
